build_hydra_model: build a HydraModel with a backbone and output heads for molecular property prediction
create_head_interface: create a HeadInterface subclass to define custom prediction heads for atomic data
implement_backbone_interface: implement a BackboneInterface subclass to generate embeddings from atomic structure data
setup_tasks_hydra_model: setup tasks on a HydraModel instance from checkpoint config to enable multi-task inference
prepare_model_for_inference: prepare a HydraModel for inference by calling prepare_for_inference with atomic data and settings
